Payments In and Out by Week

Dear {col:groups.leader}, the price is {col:groups.price_pp} per person for {col:groups.size} travellers, which is {col:groups.group_sales} for the group. The plan has {col:groups.instalments} payments.

The deposit is due on {col:groups.deposit_due} and the final payment on {col:groups.final_due}. The amounts of the other instalments are on the Payment Plans sheet. Payments received so far: {col:groups.collected}.
Each traveller pays their own share unless you tell us otherwise. A payment that is more than a few days late may put the group place at risk, so please tell us early about any problem.
Price per person: {col:travellers.price_pp}. Paid to date: {col:travellers.paid_to_date}. Name change fee, if any: {col:travellers.change_fee}.
Please pay the balance by the dates on your payment schedule. Keep this statement with your travel papers and contact us with any question.

Travel starts on {col:groups.start_date}. The pre-departure briefing is on {col:groups.briefing_date}. Your group leader is {col:groups.leader} and your advisor is {col:groups.advisor}. The full day-by-day itinerary is sent with your trip documents.
Group rules: be at every meeting point ten minutes early, carry your documents with you, tell the leader if you leave the group, and tell us at once about a medical or dietary need.
Before you travel, check the destination's current entry, passport and health rules. Your passport must be valid as the destination requires.
Dietary and access summary for suppliers
Dietary and access summary of {set:company}, dated {today}, for {col:groups.name} at {col:groups.hotel}.
Group size: {col:groups.size}. Travellers with a dietary or access need: {col:groups.needs_total}. Group arrives on {col:groups.start_date}.

The list of needs by kind is on the Dietary and Access sheet. Please confirm in writing that your kitchen and your rooms can meet each need, and tell us about any extra cost before the rooming deadline of {col:groups.rooming_deadline}.
Room block summary of {set:company}, dated {today}. Hotel: {col:blocks.hotel}. Group: {col:blocks.group_name}.

Room type: {col:blocks.room_type}. Rooms held: {col:blocks.rooms_held}. Rooms used: {col:blocks.rooms_used}. Rooms free: {col:blocks.rooms_free}. Rate per room night: {col:blocks.rate} for {col:blocks.nights} nights.
Release date: {col:blocks.release_date}, which is {col:blocks.days_to_release} days from today. Rooms we plan to release: {col:blocks.release_qty}. Status: {col:blocks.release_flag}.
Please confirm the release date and the cut-off terms of the contract in writing.

The supplier contract has a cut-off on {col:attrition.cutoff_date} with a minimum of {col:attrition.min_numbers} travellers. Travellers ready today: {col:attrition.ready}. Travellers short: {col:attrition.short}.

If the minimum is not reached by the cut-off, the supplier may charge {col:attrition.penalty_pct} of the price for each traveller short, which would be {col:attrition.penalty_amount} for the group today.
Please help us confirm the missing travellers, or tell us if the group size will change. We can ask the supplier to lower the minimum.
Leader briefing of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear {col:groups.leader}, thank you for leading {col:groups.name}.

Your group of {col:groups.size} travellers goes to {col:groups.destination} from {col:groups.start_date}. The briefing is on {col:groups.briefing_date}. Travellers placed in a room: {col:groups.placed}; still to place: {col:groups.missing}. The rooming deadline is {col:groups.rooming_deadline}.
Your leader benefit is on the Leader Benefits sheet. Please keep the group informed about payment dates, bring a copy of the traveller list and tell {col:groups.advisor} at once if anything changes.
Group margin report of {set:company}, dated {today}. Group: {col:group_trips.group_name}.

Travellers: {col:group_trips.travellers}. Total price: {col:group_trips.total_price}. Supplier net price: {col:group_trips.supplier_net}. Expected commission: {col:group_trips.commission_expected}. Service fee: {col:group_trips.service_fee}.

Margin: {col:group_trips.margin}, which is {col:group_trips.margin_pp} per traveller and {col:group_trips.margin_net} of the net price. The host agency keeps {col:group_trips.host_share}. Check against the target: {col:group_trips.margin_flag}.

Open Start and type your company name and your limits in the yellow cells: the margin wanted per traveller, travellers for each free place, the single supplement, seats in a coach and the days before a payment is late.
Check Team, Clients and Supplier Contacts. They hold the leaders, the advisors and the supplier group desks that every other sheet looks up.
Enter each group on Groups with its leader, dates, size, price per person and rooming deadline. Travellers placed, travellers missing and the deadline countdown fill in.
List every traveller on Travellers with room type, room, passport, dietary need and the amount paid. Then write one line per room on Rooming List.
Record the hotel blocks on Room Blocks with the release date and the rate. Rooms used, rooms free and rooms to release fill in.
Set the payment steps on Payment Plans and log every instalment on Group Payments. Days late and the payment check fill in.
Put each supplier cut-off on Attrition and Cut-offs and see the travellers short and the penalty at risk before the date.
Use Group Trips for the price, net, commission and margin per traveller, and Group Bookings for the supplier deposits and final payments.
Keep Group Documents, Dietary and Access, Transfers and Flights and Excursions and Meals up to date for each group.
Track Group Tasks, Leader Benefits and Group Enquiries so nothing is forgotten and every leader benefit is known.
Use the 14 calculators for rooming, room counts, group prices, free places, payment plans, attrition, block release, coaches, margins, balances, name changes, diets, leader benefits and what-ifs.
Read the Group Dashboard and Charts every week: rooming deadlines, payments, blocks, passports, needs, tasks and margin.

Suppliers with terms, sales, commission and score
One row per supplier: category, contact, commission rate, payment terms and group; bookings, sales, commission earned, unpaid commission, days to pay, score and rank fill in by themselves.
One row per booking with a supplier: category, dates, gross price, commission and net price; the margin, margin share, destination and whether the booking is live fill in by themselves.
Commissions with days to pay and the unpaid amount
One row per expected commission (the share of the price a supplier pays after travel): amounts and dates; the days to pay, the unpaid amount, its age and the chase step fill in by themselves.
Trips with price, commission and fee
One row per trip: client, type, destination, dates, advisor, price, supplier net, expected commission and service fee; the earnings before shares and their share of the price fill in by themselves.
Supplier scorecards with a weighted score
One row per review of a supplier: price, service, reliability and payment speed from 1 to 5; the weighted score, the quarter and whether it meets your minimum fill in by themselves.
Supplier contacts with role and last check
One row per person at a supplier: role, phone, e-mail and region; the years known, days since the details were checked and the check step fill in by themselves.
Supplier terms with the contract end date
One row per supplier: when commission is paid, the deposit, change and cancellation rules and the date the terms end; the days left and the renewal step fill in by themselves.
Supplier issues with cost and days open
One row per problem caused by a supplier: trip, kind, cost to the business and the date it was solved; the days open, whether it was solved in time and the step fill in by themselves.
Preferred supplier deals with sales against target
One row per preferred supplier deal: year, bonus rate, sales target and status; the sales so far, the gap, the bonus earned and still possible and the step fill in by themselves.
Familiarisation trips and training with bookings after
One row per training, event or familiarisation trip (a discounted trip for advisors to learn a place): cost; the bookings and commission that followed and the return fill in by themselves.
Payments the agency makes to suppliers
One row per deposit, final payment or penalty the agency pays a supplier: due date, paid date and status; the days late and the payment step fill in by themselves.
One row per fee invoiced to a client: trip, kind, amount and dates; the days to pay, the income, the unpaid amount and the days open fill in by themselves.
Service fee schedule with the waiver rule
One row per paid service the business charges: unit, fee and whether it is waived for a repeat client; the fee for a repeat client and its share of the average trip price fill in by themselves.
Fee reviews with the effect on income
One row per fee change: the old and new fee and the bookings it touched; the change, the effect on income and the step fill in by themselves.
Trip profitability from price to net earnings
One row per booked trip: advisor, other costs and hours; sales, commission, fee, host agency share, advisor payout, net earnings, margin and income per hour fill in by themselves.
Supplier categories by year with sales and commission
One row per supplier category and year: how many bookings, how much sales and commission; the commission rate, share of the year, days to pay, score and issues fill in by themselves.
One row per month for the last 14 months: sales, commission and bookings count themselves from Bookings; the commission rate follows.
Suppliers that work well for each destination
One row per destination and supplier pair used on real trips: speciality and notes; the trips booked, sales, score and payment check fill in by themselves.
One row per supplier you may replace: the alternative in the same category, the reason, the price difference and the decision; the commission rates and scores of both fill in by themselves.
Team with hours, advisor share and trip earnings
The owner advisor, four advisors and seven freelance specialists with hours a week and advisor share of the agency commission; the trips and net earnings of each fill in by themselves.
